blocks.html: Whether you are looking for energy or happiness, sleep or relaxation, 1906 has you covered. Rather than going for weird or crazy flavor combinations, 1906 focuses on simple flavors in dark and milk weed chocolate,incorporating exotic herbs to give the desired effect promoted so prominently on their labels.
GO
Chocolate: Dark Chocolate Gems - OR - Dark Chocolate Covered Coffee Beans
Dose: 5mg THC + 5mg CBD from Single-strain Cannabis Sativa - OR - 1mg THC + 1mg CBD (Coffee Beans)
Supplements: Caffeine, L-theanine, Galangal, Theobromine
Effects: A boost of energy!
BLISS
Chocolate: Dark or Milk Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups
Dose: 5mg THC + 5mg CBD from Single-strain Cannabis
Supplements: Kanna, Magnolia, L-theanine, Theobromine
Effects: Mood elevation in the vein of #BlissedOut
CHILL
Chocolate: Dark Milk Chocolate Gems
Dose: 5mg THC + 25mg CBD from Single-strain Cannabis Indica
Supplements: L-theanine, Magnolia
Effects: A feeling of ease and serenity
MIDNIGHT
Chocolate: Dark Milk Chocolate Gems
Dose: 5mg THC + 5mg CBD from Single-strain Cannabis Indica
Supplements: Corydalis
Effects: A sleep aid that won’t leave you with a groggy feeling the next morning
HIGH LOVE
Chocolate: Dark Chocolate Gems - OR - Dark Milk Chocolate Covered Coffee Beans
Dose: 5mg THC + 5mg CBD from Blue Dream Cannabis
Herbs: Damiana, Catuaba, Theobromine, Ashwagandha, Muira Puama
Effects: Read on for all the deets...
Since the month of February brings us Valentine’s Day, let’s focus on what the world needs a lot more of…love.

The 1906 High Love line up consists of both weed chocolates and chocolate covered coffee beans infused with cannabis (even if like me you aren’t a fan of coffee, the blend of semi-sweet chocolate along with roasty, bitter coffee beans is delicious!). These are referred to as “aphrodisiac chocolates” and from speaking to people who have used them, combined with my own personal experience, I can assure you they do what they promise. In addition to the delicious chocolate and coffee beans these products are made with 4 other herbs meant to enhance arousal, libido and that overall feeling of love. First up on the herb list is damiana which is thought to curb your inhibitions. Next we have Catuaba, thought to increase desire. The not so easy to say Ashwagandha is present to help reduce your stress levels while the Theobromine which is naturally present in chocolate will give your energy a little boost. The final kicker is Muira Puama which has many uses but as far as love goes, this herb has been referred to as “the Viagra of the Amazon”. Of course, we can’t forget about the bud itself which happens to be the classic Blue Dream strain. The overall high from these is very pleasant and the “love” portion of the product seems to kick in a bit before the high which helps deliver ultimate pleasurable experience from your edibles. Don’t worry though because even if you don’t currently have that significant other to share your love with, these High Love products work as an uplifting mood enhancer and you will find yourself falling head over heels with everything from the trail you are hiking to the creepy David Lynch movie you’re streaming. All in all, I can’t think of a better way to celebrate Valentine’s Day than by hitting up a classy restaurant,then coming home to indulge in delicious weed chocolate edibles that will only be part of your dessert ; )

Interested in trying 1906 for yourself? Stop by any Colorado Starbuds location, purchase any 1906 product and receive a High Love chocolate (of equal or lesser value), Limited Edition Love Glasses and a card for your Valentine, all for only $1!
ABOUT ED
